title: GHULAM DASTAGIR
en: One man risked his own life and saved thousands.
The poisonous gas had reached the station.
A crowded express train stood at the platform.
He did not wait for orders. He sent the train off ahead of time.
Then he stayed at his post and kept warning the other stations,
so that no other train would stop in Bhopal.
The gas from that night left him ill for the rest of his life.
Remember heroes like him. Subscribe to the channel.
